fields.description: The tenant's domain, without https:// and without a trailing slash — for example example.eu.auth0.com. A custom domain works here too.
fields.label: Domain

fields.description: Only needed on a tenant using a custom domain, where tokens must still be requested for the canonical https://<tenant>.auth0.com/api/v2/ audience. Left blank it is derived from the domain above, which is right for every other tenant.
fields.label: Audience

fields.description: The database connection new accounts are created in. Leave it alone unless the tenant renamed its default.
fields.label: Connection

fields.description: From the Auth0 application authorized for the Management API.
fields.label: Client ID

fields.description: Stored encrypted and never shown again once saved. The application needs the scopes the action being used requires — create:users and read:users to create accounts, update:users to change them, delete:users to remove them.
fields.label: Client Secret
